title.en: Our school symbol, the state tableau and what you can do

text.en: The class is asked to design an emblem for their school using symbols, words, shapes and colours, and to choose a tree, bird, animal or flower as the school symbol.

Activity: list the items of your state tableau, and make a poster or a model of it.
Find out your state animal, bird, tree and flower with your teacher's help.
Spot a tree, bird, animal, flower or object near your school, choose one as the school symbol, draw it and write one line about why.
Design an emblem for your school: think about the message you want to give with symbols, words, shapes and colours.
Think about the national fruit: which fruit would you suggest and why?
Write five rules followed at your school, and one new rule you would make.
Make a musical instrument from locally available materials, and find the states where dance forms began on a map.
Reflect: which Indian language would you like to learn and why? Which monuments appear on the notes? The Rs 10 note shows the Sun temple of Konark.
(additional, not in the textbook) A simple table of denomination and monument helps you remember the currency note facts.

problem.en: How can you choose a school symbol?

text.en: Look around school for a tree, bird, animal or flower.
Write one line why it suits the school.
